subject: Request to move Friday demo — overlap with site visit
messages:
From: Maya Turrell <maya.turrell@sunrisehealth.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Sunrise Health Scheduling <scheduling@sunrisehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 09:12:34 -0800
Subject: Request to move Friday demo — overlap with site visit

Hi Ava,

Quick note — our clinical operations team just confirmed a mandatory site visit on Friday (11/20) that will pull our team from the office for most of the day. We were due to do the product walkthrough at 11:00 AM PT.

Is there any flexibility to move the live demo? If not, would you be able to record the session so we can review it asynchronously? I can also join a 30-45 minute Q&A the following week.

Proposed windows that work for us: Mon 11/23 (9:00–11:30 PT) or Tue 11/24 (13:00–16:00 PT). If neither works, please suggest an alternative.

Thanks — apologize for the late change. Attached our travel itinerary in case that helps coordinate.

Best,
Maya Turrell
Program Manager, Clinical Ops
Sunrise Health
[Attachment: travel_itinerary.pdf (application/pdf, 84 KB)]

From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
To: Maya Turrell <maya.turrell@sunrisehealth.com>
Cc: Sunrise Health Scheduling <scheduling@sunrisehealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 11:03:11 -0800
Subject: Re: Request to move Friday demo — overlap with site visit

Hi Maya — thanks for the heads up, and no worries at all. Happy to adapt.

Quick options from our side:
- We can move the live walkthrough to Monday 11/23 at 10:00 AM PT (60–75 min). Monica can lead the live demo.
- Or we can record the originally-planned Friday session and share the recording + a 30-minute live office hours on Tue 11/24 at 2:00 PM PT for questions. Ben would host that Q&A.

If you want a recording-only option, we will also include a short checklist tailored to on-prem/private deployment concerns (helps your facilities team). I've attached a draft site checklist.

Please reply with which option you prefer and whether your facilities/security folks should be invited to the office hours. If neither Mon/Tue works we can propose the following week; we have limited on-site availability in Dec so want to lock something that works.

- Ava

Ava Chen
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.com | (415) 555-0119
[Attachment: site_checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 26 KB)]

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 11:17:42 -0800
Subject: RE: Request to move Friday demo — overlap with site visit

Thanks — if they take Monday at 10:00 AM PT I can lead the live walk-through (I have experience with Sunrise's compliance questions from last year). If they prefer the recording route, I can run the office hours on Tue 11/24 at 2:00 PM PT. Either way I can prep the compliance/IT slides and be on the recording.

If Monday is live, Ben — can you bring the sample latency/cost numbers for the dedicated + private options? If we go recorded, Ben, please be on the 2:00 PM Q&A.

M
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com

From: Maya Turrell <maya.turrell@sunrisehealth.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.com>
Cc: Sunrise Health Scheduling <scheduling@sunrisehealth.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Nov 2026 17:08:02 -0800
Subject: Re: Request to move Friday demo — overlap with site visit

Hi Ava,

Monday 11/23 at 10:00 AM PT works for our group — we'll plan for the live session. Please include the facilities lead (I copied scheduling) so they can join for the first 20 minutes to review deployment requirements. If anything changes on our side because the site visit runs long, we'll default to the recorded session and join the Tue 11/24 office hours.

Can you confirm you'll send a calendar invite to the full attendee list and share the recording after the session? Also please include the site checklist you mentioned.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Maya

[Calendar: Invite scheduled for Mon 2026-11-23 10:00–11:15 PT]
